title: Colours and Ripeness - Piros és érett
grammar: colours and ripeness; adjective before the noun; a piros almát

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe fruit and vegetables by colour, like A paradicsom piros and A banán sárga.
I can say that produce is ripe, fresh or sour, like A körte érett, az alma friss and a citrom savanyú.
I can ask for a particular piece by its colour, like Kérem a piros almát and Egy zöld körtét kérek.
